extracted.intended_audience: professional photographers, photo editors and other photography-sector professionals seeking accreditation for the Visa pour l'Image festival
extracted.subtask_description: Information and rules for applying for professional accreditation to attend the Visa pour l'Image festival's professional week, including eligibility, benefits, cost, pickup/payment logistics, application opening date, and pre-registration data-handling details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility and applicability period
rubrics_metrics.description: Accreditation is for professionals and only applies during the professional week (first week of the festival).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each edition opens with the professional week. This is a unique opportunity for photographers, photo editors and other key players from the sector to meet. Accreditation is for professionals and only applies during the professional week (first week of the festival). Accreditation also helps to support the festival so that it can continue to be free for the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access without accreditation (what is free)
rubrics_metrics.description: Visitors without accreditation can see exhibitions and attend screenings and certain events for free, subject to limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Free access to the exhibitions from 10am to 8pm. Access to the evening screenings (subject to availability). Access to the meetings, debates and discussions at the Palais des Congrès (except those for professionals only). Access to visits with the exhibiting photographers. Access to book signings (at the Cajélice bookshop, Couvent des Minimes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Access with accreditation (benefits)
rubrics_metrics.description: Holders of accreditation gain expanded and priority access across festival activities and additional professional services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early access to exhibitions (from 9am Thursday to Saturday). Priority access to the screenings. Access to all the meetings, debates and discussions at the Palais des Congrès. Access to visits with the exhibiting photographers. Access to book signings (at the Cajélice bookshop, Couvent des Minimes). Access to the Canon area (Palais des Congrès) and to expert technicians from Canon Professional services (CPs) to check your Canon equipment and learn about the brand's latest innovations. Access to portfolio reviews with international photo editors and the ANI (Association Nationale des Iconographes). Mention in the "Who's in Perpignan" list of professionals present in Perpignan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accreditation fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost to obtain accreditation for professionals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: With accreditation: 35 € (the ideal way to make the most of the festival).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accreditation application availability date
rubrics_metrics.description: When the accreditation application form will be available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The accreditation application form will be available from July 1, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pick-up location for accreditation
rubrics_metrics.description: Where to pick up accreditation on site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment methods for accreditation
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted payment methods when picking up accreditation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payment on site, cash or credit card.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-registration form save behavior and continuation
rubrics_metrics.description: How the site saves in-progress accreditation applications and how to resume them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you save your progress now, a copy of the data you have entered will be stored on this server and may be accessed by the site owner. The data entered in your form has been saved. You can use the unique link that has been created to continue filling in this form. Enter your e-mail address to receive the link by e-mail. Alternatively, you can copy and save the link below. Please note that this link should not be shared and will expire in 30 days, after which your form will be deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security and sensitive-information warning for resumed forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Warning that certain sensitive information must be re-entered when resuming a saved form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For security reasons, when you resume your entry, you'll need to specify sensitive information such as credit cards and postal addresses, as well as the files to be uploaded.
